# step_1: find time-respecting paths from 303 to 1293 within [46296,48695] with max lag 600
from collections import defaultdict, deque
import bisect

window = (46296,48695)
start_node = 303
target_node = 1293
max_lag = 600

# events is provided
# build outgoing dict: node -> list of (t, v)
out = defaultdict(list)
for u,v,t in events:
    if window[0] <= t <= window[1]:
        out[u].append((t,v))
# sort each list by time (events already sorted but per node may not be)
for u in out:
    out[u].sort()

# find starting events where u==start_node
starts = out.get(start_node, [])
print('window', window)
print('number of outgoing events from start_node in window:', len(starts))

# BFS/DFS for time-respecting paths
paths = []
max_paths = 1000

from bisect import bisect_right

# Precompute for each node their times list for bisect
times_by_node = {u: [t for (t,v) in lst] for u,lst in out.items() for u,lst in [(u,out[u])]}

# DFS stack elements: (current_node, current_time, path_list_of_tuples)
stack = []
for (t,v) in starts:
    p = [(start_node, v, t)]
    if v == target_node:
        paths.append(p)
    else:
        stack.append((v,t,p))

while stack and len(paths) < max_paths:
    cur, curt, path = stack.pop()
    # find outgoing events from cur with t' > curt and t' - curt <= max_lag
    lst = out.get(cur, [])
    if not lst:
        continue
    times = [tv for (tv,_) in lst]
    i = bisect_right(times, curt)
    # iterate forward while within lag
    while i < len(lst) and lst[i][0] - curt <= max_lag:
        t2, v2 = lst[i]
        newp = path + [(cur, v2, t2)]
        if v2 == target_node:
            paths.append(newp)
            if len(paths) >= max_paths:
                break
        else:
            stack.append((v2, t2, newp))
        i += 1

print('found_paths_count:', len(paths))
# print up to 20 paths
for idx,p in enumerate(paths[:20]):
    print('\npath', idx+1)
    for e in p:
        print(e)

# Also print whether any direct 303->1293 exists in window
direct_exists = any(v==target_node for (t,v) in starts)
print('\ndirect_edge_303_to_1293_in_window:', direct_exists)

# print times of first and last event in window involving start and target
start_times = [t for (u,v,t) in events if u==start_node and window[0]<=t<=window[1]]
target_times = [t for (u,v,t) in events if v==target_node and window[0]<=t<=window[1]]
print('start_times (303 as sender) in window:', start_times)
print('times when 1293 was a receiver in window:', target_times)

# For traceability, also print the exact events lists for nodes along first path if exists
if paths:
    print('\nfirst_path_events_verbose:')
    for e in paths[0]:
        print(e)
else:
    print('\nno time-respecting path found')

# for each recipient of 303, find their outgoing events within 600 after receipt
for (u,v,t) in outs:
    rec = v
    succ = [(a,b,tt) for (a,b,tt) in events if a==rec and tt>t and tt - t <= max_lag and window[0]<=tt<=window[1]]
    print('\nrecipient of 303:', rec, 'at', t)
    print('their successors within', max_lag, ':', succ)

# Also check if any path of length 2 via an intermediary: 303 -> x at t1, x -> 1293 at t2 within lag
pairs = []
